summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a detailed explanation of Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) status as the final prophet and his role as the Imam of all prophets and humanity. He focuses primarily on the concept of the Prophet's major intercession (shafaa'ah al-kubra) on the Day of Judgment, a distinctive honor mentioned in the Quran and authenticated hadith collections. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains this through a lengthy narration from Abu Hurairah describing the scene on the Day of Judgment, where all of humanity and jinn will be resurrected and awaiting Allah's judgment. The people, overcome by terror and anticipation, will seek an intercessor, beginning with Prophet Adam, then Noah, and Abraham, each declining due to their concern for themselves and their exhausted supplications. This narration, documented in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, illustrates why only Prophet Muhammad possesses the authority and the reserved supplication to intercede for all mankind.
